task.title: StrategySpec draft patch/version linkage
task.summary_zh: 依 SD §6/§7.4(VersionPatchProposal)整合既有 research strategy_spec:workshop_projection / patching / version_compare,提供 draft create/patch、version create/select(§17.2 versions / select-version),patch 以 JSON path from/to 形式套用,version 比較產生 diff。draft 真相留在既有 Registry,workshop 只引用。 【有疑問一定要提出,不要自己亂做】動工前先讀完引用的設計稿(SD 對應章節 + docs/04/pantheon_agora_cross_repo_2026-06-20/design-closure/ + canonical services/control-plane/specs/agora/*.schema.json / openapi/agora_v1.openapi.yaml / capability_manifest.json)。只要遇到任何疑問、不確定、設計稿沒寫到、與既有 code 對不上、依賴不清、無法重現或衝突,一律 STOP,用 blocker(或向 reviewer handoff)把問題具體寫出來並等待澄清,絕對不可自行臆測、補洞、繞過或先做再說。可動工的部分必須與引用 spec/schema 逐欄位一致:不得自創 schema/欄位/評分/widget/route、不得擴張 capability allowlist、不得讓 Agora 直接下單/綁資金/寫 RuntimeBinding。
acceptance: 可對 StrategySpec draft 套 patch 產生新 version 並選定;version diff 正確;真相落既有 Registry 不重複;附 patch/compare 單元測試;【驗收】實作與引用 spec/schema 逐欄位一致,無自創欄位/route/enum;遇疑問須先開 blocker 澄清而非自行實作;自行臆測或偏離設計稿一律不通過

handoffs.message: PR#2080 merged into dev. Implemented patching.py (RFC 6902 restricted patch engine), version_compare.py (VersionCompare builder with field/metric/readiness diffs), workshop_projection.py (WorkshopVersionLink + WorkshopProjection, patch-base SHA-256). All modules export from __init__.py. 65 unit tests pass (test_patching.py + test_version_compare.py). Design-compliance: path allowlist enforced per §A2, forbidden paths blocked, decision_authority always trader per §A5, no new schema/fields/routes created. Please review for acceptance.
Review approved: path allowlist, error codes, decision_authority, and 65 tests all correct. Returning to Claude2 for closeout.
Restoring review_approved state after accidental progress downgrade; review_notes_zh confirm Claude's approval is on record.

blockers.message: 設計稿閱讀完畢後發現 4 個具體阻擋問題，無法繼續實作，等待澄清：(1) SD §6/§7.4(VersionPatchProposal) 段落找不到：閱讀 SD_2026-06-20.md (§17 Route Catalog / §22 Contract Manifest，無此段) 和 sw001-deep-closure/AG-BE-SW-001_deep_design_closure_2026-06-21.md (§6=Canonical status model / §7.4=strategy_completeness_snapshot，均非 VersionPatchProposal)，無法確認設計依據段落。(2) patch 格式 JSON path from/to 未定義：agora_openapi_extension_v1_1.yaml VersionCreateRequest.patch 只有 {type: object, additionalProperties: true}，task brief 說「JSON path from/to 形式」但無具體 schema，無法實作 patching.py。(3) 既有 Registry 介面不明：brief 說 draft 真相留在既有 Registry，但 services/research/strategy_spec/ 無任何 Registry 客戶端；source_ingestion/registry/proposals.py 是 SourceChangeProposal 非 StrategySpec Registry，workshop_projection.py 不知道要如何讀取 Registry draft。(4) strategy_workshop_version_link table 未在 store 中：SW-001 深度設計稿 §7.3 定義了此表，但 store.py 目前沒有它，不清楚 AG-BE-SW-002 是否需要先擴展 store.py。依 task brief 指示，遇不確定一律 STOP 等待澄清，不自行臆測。
